diff_summary.content:
# Git hooks are executed by sh, which does not tolerate CRLF line endings.
# Without this pin, a Windows clone with core.autocrlf=true checks the hook
# out with CRLF and it fails at the shebang or on stray \r in every branch.
scripts/githooks/* text eol=lf
